thesis: The podcast introduces Formula 1 as a sport that evolved from dangerous post-WWII auto racing into a professionally managed, publicly traded entity owned by Liberty Media. It describes the series as a unique combination of elite driver competition, a massive engineering challenge requiring teams to build cars from scratch, and a high-stakes business involving hundreds of millions of dollars in development costs and global logistics.
